candidate: fcmgt + bit -> FSELGT (branchless select on a float compare)

provenance.corpus: Godot 4.4.1 core/math (Vector3/AABB inline methods, 4096 vertices x 24 frames)

modelled: one lane. AXIS lane-parallel float ops are fadd/fsub/fmul/fdiv/fsqrt only -- compares are deliberately excluded because a NEON lane compare writes a mask, not 1/0 -- so the vector form is not expressible and is not claimed to be proven.

obligations.claim: the fused select equals fcmgt+bit for every input, NaN included
the obvious alternative implementation differs on a NaN
